summary.zh: 用测试与数据契约搭建数据质量校验
summary.en: Build data quality checks with tests and data contracts

description.zh: 为数据管道设计校验规则，用 Great Expectations、dbt tests 和数据契约定义表与字段的预期结果。适合新管道上线前建立质量门槛，或把散落的校验规则收敛成统一标准。
description.en: Defines validation rules for data pipelines using Great Expectations, dbt tests and data contracts for tables and columns. Use it to set quality gates for a new pipeline or to unify scattered checks.
